title: seg2recon
description: Creates and populates a subjects directory from an input image and segmentation suitable for running recon-all.

segvol.description: Aseg-type volume, e.g., from synthseg, fastsurfer, psacnn, samseg, or aseg.
segvol.title: Segmentation volume

inputvol.description: Input volume as would be passed to recon-all.
inputvol.title: Input volume

ctab.description: Color table for the segmentation. Uses embedded table if available, or FreeSurferColorLUT.txt if not specified.
ctab.title: Color table

ndilate.description: Dilate binarization of segmentation when creating brainmask. Default is 2.
ndilate.title: Dilate binarization

threads.description: Number of threads to use for processing.
threads.title: Number of threads

force_update.description: Force regeneration of files whether needed or not.
force_update.title: Force update flag

mask.description: Use this mask as brainmask instead of computing from segmentation.
mask.title: Brainmask

headmask.description: Use this headmask instead of running mri_seghead.
headmask.title: Headmask

no_bias_field_cor.description: Do not compute or apply bias field correction.
no_bias_field_cor.title: No bias field correction
